description: Pacific Northwest Liquefaction Hazard Simulations is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Morgan Sanger, University of Washington-Tacoma Campus (uw.edu). This dataset contains a suite of 85 regional scenario earthquake simulations across Washington and Oregon for which the liquefaction hazard was assessed geospatially (i.e., at 90-meter resolution for the affected region) using the geospatial liquefaction model of Sanger et al. (2025). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 88 top-level files (TIF, PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-1ryc-0w40. Keywords: earthquake, scenario, Pacific Northwest, geospatial, liquefaction. Published 2025-07-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
